fields.statement: At 82b33999 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/adapter/... (ok) and TestLiveSnapshots -v (PASS); go vet and gofmt -l clean. The test writes a fake state folder's usage.live.json and reads it back through claudecode.Adapter.LiveSnapshots as one snapshot per kind (session, weekly, sorted) carrying used_percentage, resets_at and captured_at; an absent file and a corrupt file each return nil with no error (the method has no error return, so a poll cannot be stopped). Read the diff: adapter.LiveUsageReader is an optional interface with a compile-time assertion for Adapter, and the reader's file name and JSON tags match daemon.LiveFile and daemon.RecordLive's array output.
